モジュール名の商標・汎用アイコンの出典

モジュール一覧には各ソフトウェアを識別する名称と、Tabler Icons由来の汎用ピクトグラムを表示します。各プロジェクトの公式ロゴ画像は使用していません。本ツールは各権利者の公式製品ではなく、提携・承認・保証を意味しません。

Python is a trademark or registered trademark of the Python Software Foundation. The name is used only to identify the corresponding software module; this tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Foundation.
https://www.python.org/

WordPress is a registered trademark of the WordPress Foundation. The name is used only to identify the corresponding software module; this tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Foundation.
https://wordpress.org/

Redmine is used as the name identifying the corresponding software module. This tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Redmine project.
https://www.redmine.org/

Jenkins is a registered trademark of LF Charities, Inc. The name is used only to identify the corresponding software module; this tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by LF Charities or the Jenkins project.
https://www.jenkins.io/
